summary: Demote the two duplicate primary conversion actions. Twelve actions are primary today and seven of them count into the Conversions column; two of those seven duplicate another.

actions.reason: Duplicates 'Softwind Landscape & Masonry (web) form_submission' (7480764700, GA4). Both fire on the same submission and both count: Mar 1/3, Apr 3/5, May 1/1, Jun 1/1, Jul 2/2, Aug 0/1. The GA4 action is the more complete of the two and stays primary.
actions.verified_not_required_by_whatconverts: WhatConverts writes to WC Leads (UPLOAD_CLICKS, 7635680357) and WC Call (UPLOAD_CALLS, 7635680543), not to either web form action.

actions.reason: Duplicates 'Calls from ads' (7461572537). Both are AD_CALL / PHONE_CALL_LEAD and both are primary. (1) recorded Feb-Jun and has recorded nothing since June 2026; 7461572537 has carried every call credit since. In June 2026 BOTH fired - 6 and 1 - which is a duplicate-primary window that must not recur.
actions.counting_type_conflict: 7461572537 is ONE_PER_CLICK at 30 seconds; 7508686781 is MANY_PER_CLICK at 60 seconds.

held_for_a_later_package.WC Leads (7635680357): Also primary, category CONTACT, and a WhatConverts upload of the same form submissions. It is a third credit for one lead. It is NOT demoted now because it currently carries the only conversion credit the Patio campaign recorded in August, and its intended replacement - the GA4 form action - last fired 2026-08-08. Demote it only after the WhatConverts repair is verified.
held_for_a_later_package.WC Call (7635680543): Primary but has recorded ZERO conversions and zero all_conversions, in every month, on every campaign. all_conversions is not gated by goal biddability, so a zero there proves no event was ever recorded. The upload path has never worked. Fix the path before touching the flag.
held_for_a_later_package.Calls from ads minimum duration: 7461572537 counts a call at 30 seconds; every other action on the account uses 60. Raising it to 60 changes what counts as a lead and breaks comparability with history, so it needs the owner's answer - question SLM-Q7.

explicitly_left_alone.the five Google-hosted local actions: Clicks to call, Directions, Menu views, Other engagements and Website visits are primary_for_goal=true but include_in_conversions_metric=false, and their customer conversion goals (PAGE_VIEW, GET_DIRECTIONS, CONTACT/GOOGLE_HOSTED, ENGAGEMENT/GOOGLE_HOSTED) are all biddable=false. They are already correctly isolated as diagnostics. 120 'Other engagements' in Jul-Aug never entered the Conversions column. No change.
explicitly_left_alone.include_in_conversions_metric: Not touched anywhere. The field is deprecated and effectively immutable; primary_for_goal plus the goal layer is the real gate.

risk: Reported Conversions will fall. That is the point - the column has been counting one lead more than once. Historic months are NOT restated: a credit already counted stays in the historical column forever, so before/after comparisons must be drawn at the change date.
rollback: Set primary_for_goal back to true on the same two action IDs.
validation: google-ads validate_only on two conversion_action mutations
unchanged: no conversion action is deleted, renamed, recategorised or restatused; counting type, attribution model, lookback windows, value settings and call durations are all untouched; campaign and customer conversion goals are untouched
